title: Glowing rose
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b8a' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#e8345a' stop-opacity='0.7'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8b0e2e' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='petalGlow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3c1'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff5470'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c41e3a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- ambient glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='38' fill='#ff1a4a' opacity='0.12'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='30' fill='#ff3366' opacity='0.15'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='22' fill='#ff5577' opacity='0.18'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 58 Q48 70 46 82 Q45 88 44 94' stroke='#2e8b57' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 58 Q52 70 54 82 Q55 88 56 94' stroke='#3cb371' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- leaf left -->
  <path d='M48 72 Q36 66 34 72 Q38 78 48 74 Z' fill='#3cb371' />
  <path d='M48 72 Q38 70 36 72' stroke='#7fe0a0' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M34 72 Q32 68 30 64 Q36 66 38 70 Q36 72 34 72Z' fill='#2e8b57'/>

  <!-- leaf right -->
  <path d='M52 78 Q64 72 66 78 Q62 84 52 80 Z' fill='#2ecc71'/>
  <path d='M52 78 Q62 76 64 78' stroke='#8affb0' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- outer petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#e8345a' opacity='0.85'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='42' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#d42a50' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(-20 38 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='42' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#ff4d6d' opacity='0.85' transform='rotate(20 62 42)'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='30' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f03560' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(-35 44 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='30' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#ff6688' opacity='0.8' transform='rotate(35 56 30)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#c41e3a' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- mid petals -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#ff7a95' opacity='0.9'/>
  <ellipse cx='43' cy='40' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#ff5470' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(-25 43 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='40' rx='9' ry='10' fill='#ff8fa8' opacity='0.9' transform='rotate(25 57 40)'/>

  <!-- inner spiral / bud -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <path d='M50 32 Q55 36 52 40 Q48 43 47 38 Q47 34 50 32Z' fill='#ffd6de'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='3' ry='3.5' fill='#fff0f3'/>

  <!-- glowing center -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.95'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='37' r='4' fill='#ffd6de' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- highlight sparkles -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='30' r='1.2' fill='#ffe0e8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='22' r='1' fill='#fff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='48' r='1.3' fill='#ffc0d0' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
